messages:
Maya: thanks folks — quick follow-up from the infra all-hands on GPU supply / regions / autoscale. I want a short list of concrete next steps we can action this week.
Jonah: heard — will summarize. main asks I heard: EMEA region ETA, default autoscale burst cap, and fallback models.
Priya: EMEA: we're tracking two providers, current estimate is mid-May for soft capacity (non-reserved). will confirm by EOD Fri. :calendar: 
Ethan: for burst/autoscale, we need to pick a sensible default that minimizes cold starts. proposed default: min_replicas=2, burst_limit=4 per zone. thoughts?
Leah: +1 to having min_replicas>0 in zones with steady traffic. question: can we make burst_limit a per-customer override? some enterprise customers will want stricter caps.
Jonah: yes, can be per-customer via policy flag. we should document in Console > Capacity > Autoscale.
Priya: fallback models: short list is {gpt-small-quant, gpt-medium-8bit}. we will publish compatibility matrix.
Maya: good — include expected latency tradeoffs for each fallback in the matrix. ops team needs that for SLAs.
Ethan: action: I'll run synthetic load tests on the proposed min/burst config and share numbers (p50/p95 latency, token cost delta). target: tests done by Wed.
Leah: can InfraBot post the current pool sizes for prod/us-west and prod/eu-west? I want to see headroom.
InfraBot: deploy snapshot: prod-us-west: 48 gpus (24 active, 24 standby); prod-eu-west: 32 gpus (18 active, 14 standby). autoscaler status: healthy. :robot_face:
Jonah: thanks InfraBot. follow-up: if we shift reservation buys to Provider B for EMEA, we may need a 2-week migration window. will coordinate with procurement.
Priya: FYI some customers asked for private deployment timelines — we should flag that as separate to avoid blocking autoscale decisions.
Maya: agree. Leah, can you own a short doc (1 pager) separating Private deployment requirements vs Hosted autoscale defaults? deadline: next Tue.
Leah: will do.
Jonah: action items recap: Priya — confirm EMEA soft capacity ETA by Fri; Ethan — synthetic test results by Wed; Leah — 1-pager on private vs hosted by Tue; Jonah — region migration plan draft by next Mon.
Maya: thanks all. if anyone needs me for priority escalations ping me directly. :eyes: 
Ethan: small note — in tests I'll include a quick script sample: ```bash
# run 5 minute ramp test
./run-load.sh --model gpt-medium-8bit --qps 30 --duration 300
```
Priya: saved. also adding the fallback latency numbers to the matrix doc.
Leah: leaving a quick comment: we should communicate any potential capacity shortfalls to Sales before we finalize burst defaults.
Jonah: will add a short blurb for Sales and Post-sales playbook.
Maya: great. closing this thread — please update the doc links in the All-Hands followups thread when ready. :white_check_mark:
